note.after_visit_summary: Your diabetes is not at goal, with recent A1C of 8.4%. You stopped glipizide because it caused low blood sugar, including shakiness and sweating, and one episode where your sugar dropped to 62. Since stopping it, you have not had low sugars. You continue metformin 1000 mg twice daily, which agrees with your stomach. Your fasting sugars run 150-180 in the morning. You are a little more thirsty but not up at night. Your feet feel normal, and your eye exam was before COVID. Your blood pressure is 128/76, pulse 80, weight 186 lbs. Kidney function is normal. We are stopping glipizide for good. Continue metformin 1000 mg twice daily. Start empagliflozin 10 mg once daily in the morning. This medicine helps remove sugar through urine, so drink plenty of water and keep the genital area clean. Call if you get itching or a yeast infection—it can be treated. If you are sick and cannot eat or drink, skip empagliflozin that day. Keep up your evening walks. You need a diabetic eye exam—we’ve referred you, and the info will go to your portal. Return in 3 months for a repeat A1C.
